notes: Okres Benešov with its Prague lines (332, 337, 339 from Budějovická; 382, 383 from Háje; 406, 426, 401, 408 from Roztyly) and the lines from the Jihočeský kraj and Vysočina that reach it (401, 408, 453, 455, 456, 457, 459, 846, 865, 866, 867). Every terminus is a loop: each typed value is the real minute − 1. Outstation lines (339, 382, 755: the buses sleep at the far end) are timed both ways at the inbound rate; their extra departures towards the far end are listed, as the owner set on 25 Oct 2026. Where the real timetable sends the arriving bus straight back (426 and 406 at Roztyly, 453 at Tábor and Mladá Vožice, 794 at Vlašim, 840, 841, MHD Benešov 3, 848 Zdiměřice), the leg has a 0-minute wait so the bus count follows the real turn; this assumes the fork's automatic Leave up to lets a bus that arrives on the real minute leave although the loop rule typed it 1 min earlier (an engine question, still to confirm). Vlašim, Terminál is a timed pulse at :50, when 426 leaves for Prague and 790, 455, 842 and others arrive (their 0-minute chains to 426 are this connection, not through buses). Through-running seen in the timetable, to confirm on the live map of 2 Nov: 337's Benešov – Nespeky shorts run on as 651 to Pyšely (all of them); 408 and 459 buses go on as 453 at Tábor (9 of 16, 5 of 11); the Sulice, Želivec shorts of 339 follow 335 arrivals (7 of 7); MHD Benešov 4 is interlined with 1 and 2. Pooling (not applied): 426's Prague trips and its Benešov shorts turn into each other at Vlašim in about 10 minutes; 791's two ends alternate at Benešov (3 buses as one circuit instead of 4); 752 Týnec's shorts fit in the Jílové buses' 55-minute layover at Benešov (752 and 752 Týnec, 5 buses, about 3 pooled); 453 Vlašim runs with 453 at Tábor and Mladá Vožice (4 buses, 3 pooled). X390 (Rabyně – Slapy) replaces line 390's closed section over the Slapy dam until 31 Dec 2027 and is modelled as it runs. Alternative to 651 Nespeky, if the real working should show: one circuit 651 Benešov every 120 (Benešov 15:29 → Nespeky as 337, on at 15:48 → Pyšely as 651, Pyšely 14:55 → Nespeky, on at 15:02 → Benešov as 337), 1 bus, the same as now. Owner, 2 Nov 2026: places whose only afternoon service is PID Haló (on demand) get a Simutrans line from their fixed trips, at most every 480 (here 848 Zdiměřice, which also runs Haló 887's Novotinky loop).
